_README: RELEASE DISCLOSURE POLICY. Only this shipped file is read; widening requires approved self-change.
recipient  — the ONE host disclosures may be addressed to. A disclosure to any other host is refused.
allowed    — the class ceiling for that host; providerSendConsent must separately be explicitly true.
turn-text      what you said this turn
history        earlier turns, as she recalls them
screen         anything visible on your screen        (OFF by default)
repo           files or excerpts from a repository    (OFF by default)
organism-state the organism's own state document      (OFF by default)
memory         records from her memory store
A class that is not listed is refused. Local logs name the reason; the client shows a blocked icon. It is never
sent with a different label. An unreadable or malformed file authorises NOTHING — it does not fall
back to this default, because a missing release file must not restore authorisations.
No owner-file or environment override is accepted. A missing release policy also authorises nothing.
